visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network with backpropagation error hints. Three horizontal rows and six node columns. Column 1: blue Σ nodes receiving Input Sample and Node Bias. Column 2: red f nodes producing O_i. Column 3: blue Σ nodes labeled Net_j. Column 4: red f nodes labeled O_j. Column 5: yellow Σ nodes labeled Net_k. Column 6: red f nodes labeled O_k. Solid black arrows show forward signal flow left-to-right, including all-to-all connections between adjacent columns. Labels on forward paths include O_i, W_ji, Net_j, O_j, W_jk, Net_k, and O_k. Dashed blue/red arrows show backward error information from Target Label/outputs toward Net_k and earlier layers. Output boxes read Output 1, Output 2, Output m; right-side class labels read Class 1, Class 2, Class m; red vertical Error annotations appear along the error path.
Bottom-left formula panel headed 'For Layer "j"' containing the Net_j and logistic O_j equations.
Bottom-right note panel containing 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'.
